procedure_column: Ma+2015 | Caltech GPS | WDS Point Analysis (JEOL 8200)

Procedure Name.cell: EPMA-WDS Major Element Silicates/Oxides, Tissint Mars Meteorite (Caltech GPS, JEOL 8200)
Procedure Name.value: EPMA-WDS Major Element Silicates/Oxides, Tissint Mars Meteorite (Caltech GPS, JEOL 8200)

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Ma et al. 2015, Earth Planet. Sci. Lett. 422:194-205; doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2015.03.057
Procedure Reference(s).value: Ma et al. 2015, Earth Planet. Sci. Lett. 422:194-205; doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2015.03.057

Coupled Technique(s).cell: SEM (Carl Zeiss 1550VP FE-SEM, BSE imaging); EBSD (HKL system on ZEISS 1550VP); synchrotron XRD; micro-Raman
Coupled Technique(s).value: SEM (Carl Zeiss 1550VP FE-SEM, BSE imaging); EBSD (HKL system on ZEISS 1550VP); synchrotron XRD; micro-Raman

Target Material.cell: tissintite; maskelynite; pigeonite; fayalite — Table 1: wormy and rimming tissintite, associated maskelynite, pigeonite and fayalite surrounding tissintite

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Polished thin section; carbon coating N
Sample Preparation Method.value: Polished thin section; carbon coating N

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Phase > Analysis point — Table 1 reports one column per phase and textural setting ("Wormy type tissintite", "Maskelynite away from melt pockets" …), each the mean of n = 5–17 focused-beam point analyses (p.5)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Textural position relative to the shock-melt pockets — the analyses are grouped as "Wormy type tissintite", "Rimming tissintite", "Maskelynite associated with wormy tissintite" and "Maskelynite away from melt pockets" (Table 1, p.5), the phase itself occurring "only in maskelynite less than ~25 μm of a shock melt pocket" (p.1)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Textural position relative to the shock-melt pockets

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: SEM BSE imaging on a ZEISS 1550VP field-emission SEM, which locates the occurrences the probe then analyses — "SEM BSE image showing tissintite in a shock melt pocket, in Tissint section UT2" (Fig. 1 caption, p.2). The paper lists EPMA, SEM, EBSD, synchrotron XRD and micro-Raman as one suite (p.2) without stating the order
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: SEM BSE imaging on a ZEISS 1550VP field-emission SEM, which locates the occurrences the probe then analyses

Instrument Model.cell: JEOL 8200 (stated as "JEOL 8200 electron microprobe"; no JXA prefix stated)
Instrument Model.value: JEOL 8200 (stated as "JEOL 8200 electron microprobe"; no JXA prefix stated)

Beam Mode.cell: all: Focused — 'WDS: 15 kV; 5 nA; beam in focused mode' (p.3)

Beam Diameter.cell: N — 'beam in focused mode' is recorded under Beam Mode; no diameter is given

Target Species.cell: Si, Ti, Al, Cr, Fe, Mn, Mg, Ca, Na, K — from the standards sentence (p.3)

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: Si, Al, Ca, Na, Fe, Mg, Mn, Ti, Cr, K — all determined; no monitor-only element. "Standards for analysis were anorthite (SiKα, AlKα, CaKα); albite (NaKα); fayalite (FeKα); forsterite (MgKα); Mn2SiO4 (MnKα); TiO2 (TiKα); Cr2O3 (CrKα); and microcline (KKα)" (p.3)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, FeO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O, Cr2O3, MnO; cations per formula unit; Ca/(Ca+Na+K); Ca-Eskola component; An content of the precursor plagioclase — oxide wt% with totals and 1 s.d. of the mean, cations on 6 or 8 oxygens (Table 1); Ca-Eskola (mol%) and An58–69 (p.1)

value.member: An content of the precursor plagioclase

X-ray Line.cell: Si, Al, Ca, Na, Fe, Mg, Mn, Ti, Cr, K: Ka — 'anorthite (SiKα, AlKα, CaKα); albite (NaKα); fayalite (FeKα); forsterite (MgKα); Mn2SiO4 (MnKα); TiO2 (TiKα); Cr2O3 (CrKα); and microcline (KKα)'

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — the contributing counts are stated per aggregate, each Table 1 column being the mean of n point analyses of one phase and textural setting (n = 6, 6, 6, 9, 17, 7 and 5; p.5), with one standard deviation of the mean. No acceptance or rejection rule, and no acquired-versus-included count, is stated

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Si, Al, Ca: anorthite; Na: albite; Fe: fayalite; Mg: forsterite; Mn: Mn2SiO4; Ti: TiO2; Cr: Cr2O3; K: microcline] — p.3

Detection Limit.cell: K2O: 0.02 wt% K; Cr2O3: 0.05 wt% Cr; MnO: 0.06 wt% Mn; other: N — Table 1 footnote c, attached to the b.d. entries of the K2O, Cr2O3 and MnO rows: 'b.d. = below detection limit: 0.02 wt% K, 0.05 wt% Cr, 0.06 wt% Mn'

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Ma et al. 2015, Earth Planet. Sci. Lett. — tissintite discovery paper (Tissint Mars meteorite). Instrument stated as "JEOL 8200 electron microprobe" (no JXA prefix). WDS explicitly stated ("WDS: 15 kV; 5 nA; beam in focused mode"). Point analysis only; no X-ray mapping reported. Probe for EPMA stated; CITZAF correction procedure (Armstrong 1995). Full standard suite with X-ray lines given. Detection limits: K=0.02, Cr=0.05, Mn=0.06 wt% from Table 1 footnote. Caltech GPS Division Analytical Facility.
Additional Notes.value: Ma et al. 2015, Earth Planet. Sci. Lett.
